lines.zh: 吉尔伯特住院的时候，他问医生他的手术是否成功，但医生拒绝告诉他。

lines.en: While John Gilbert was in hospital, he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful, but the doctor refused to do so.
lines.zh: 第二天，这位病人要了一部床头电话。

lines.en: The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
lines.zh: 当房里只剩他一个人时，他接通了医院的交换台，要求与米灵顿医生讲话。

lines.en: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
lines.zh: 当这位医生接过电话时，吉尔伯特先生说他想询问一个病人的情况，是一位名叫约翰。

lines.en: When the doctor answered the phone, Mr.. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr.. John Gilbert.
He asked if Mr.. Gilbert's operation had been successful and the doctor told him that it had been.
lines.zh: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术中否成功，医生告诉他手术很成功。

lines.en: He then asked when Mr.. Gilbert would be allowed to go home and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
lines.zh: 然后他又问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以回家，医生说他在医院还必须再住上两个星期。

lines.en: Then Dr.. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
lines.zh: 之后，米灵顿医生问打电话的人是否是病人的亲属。

lines.en: 'No,' the patient answered, 'I am Mr.. John Gilbert.'
lines.zh: “不是，”病人回答说，“我就是约翰。吉尔伯特先生。”
